key_insight: Automated discovery scales better when agent memory is periodically reset: forgetting breaks anchoring to past attempts and enables larger improvements from the same compute budget.
engineering_relevance: For AI research systems and optimization pipelines, managing what agents remember can be as important as adding more agents, more iterations, or more communication.
method: Run multiple LLM agents with iterative refinement and communication.
Periodically discard each agent’s session and candidate history.
Restart from the best candidate found so far to continue search without accumulated bias.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on four tasks spanning heuristic programming, kernel optimization, and model training, with up to 15% better results than parallel agents and up to 39% better than a single agent.
watch_item: Periodic reset may discard useful context, so the restart policy and best-candidate selection need careful tuning for each task.
